says: The rules and records build plan is wrong for slice 7 in three places, kept for the merger's one plan fix at the end (no slice edits the plan). (1) Slice 7's list also holds the hand-overs: 0022 (successor 0069) and 0049 (0162) from slice 1, 0063 (0525) from slice 2, 0539 (0584) from slice 5, 0129 and 0608 (both 0610) from slice 6, and 0600:83's still-holds sentence from slice 5. (2) Once the status decodes, the link check flags links to records slices 6 and 7 superseded. Slice 7 rewrites two of them: .agents/skills/sev/SKILL.md:62 (0539 to 0584) and docs/plan/README.md:556 (0063 to 0525). Pull request 1659 fixed docs/guidelines/rules-and-records.md:120 (0608 to 0610). Two stay, in signed plans: docs/plan/quests/full-run-cadence-PLAN.md:33 (0539), which goes when slice 9 makes the link check skip docs/plan/quests/, and docs/plan/quests/rules-and-records-build-PLAN.md:14 (0608), which goes when the lead folds every plan correction into the plan in one docs pull request with a fresh sign. (3) Four records on no slice's list fail the status check with a YAML parse error at frontmatter line 2: 0099, 0105, 0255 and 0582. They stay with slice 9.
proof: `node kalfa/records/src/bin.ts check` prints 21 findings on main at c3dac8ab and 6 at the slice 7 head after main is merged in: the two signed-plan links and the four parse errors above. The hand-overs are named in pull requests 1628, 1629 and 1642 and in slice 6's pull request 1633.
cost: Slice 9 would turn on a check that fails on main, and editing a signed plan or an approved guidelines page to pass it would break the plan's signature or skip the owner's yes.
